leadText:
Sophia (Japanese: ソフィア Sophia) is a character of the day who appeared in Moving Pictures, She lives with her husband of 50 years, Marcello, at the Sunflora Lodge, which they run together.

Sophia and Marcello married 50 years ago and took a picture with hundreds of . They continued this tradition for the next 49 wedding anniversaries. On their 50th anniversary, however, the weather was particularly cold and the Sunflora never appeared at the usual south slope location.

 was able to use his Sun Stone that he won as a prize in the Bug-Catching Contest to evolve a recently rescued into a Sunflora. This Sunflora went on to call the other Sunflora over, allowing Sophia and Marcello to maintain their anniversary tradition, and took the commemorative snapshot.

Sophia enjoys telling travelers romantic stories about herself and Marcello. However, these tales aren't completely true and are inspired by the many romance novels and movies she enjoys.
